problems.problem: The plaque band is set in dark ink #22140c directly on the mid-value hammered copper: in the poster the logo, title and subtitle sit over dimple highlights and shadow pits (e.g. bright dents crowding 'TOBACCO VANILLE' at y 230-273), so legibility depends on local texture luck and the type reads as stamped onto noise rather than printed on a prepared plaque field. The references all reserve a calmer or higher-contrast value zone for type; here the busiest texture runs straight through the铭牌 band.

The dimple texture is uniform in scale and brightness from edge to edge and from top to bottom, so the 'vertical tonal falloff' and niche idea never actually appear in the render. Compared with the references' controlled light gradients (Hermès dust falloff, YSL bokeh depth), this backdrop is a flat repeating pattern; it also presses equally hard behind the plaque band and behind the bottle, flattening the intended above-text / below-image hierarchy.

The contact detail crop [266,1185,815,1435] confirms a real contact shadow: a thin dark seam hugs the base edge with correct zero offset, so the bottle is not floating. However, in the same crop the copper immediately below and beside the base keeps the same brightness and dimple contrast as the rest of the wall: a broad soft frontal light plus warm metallic bounce would pool slightly under and behind the object. The grounding is therefore only a line, not an illumination event, and the bright specular cap highlights on the bottle have no corresponding response in the backdrop.

Geometry is sound (height ratio 0.60, base at 92% of canvas, no text/product overlap, decoration line correctly separating plaque from image), but the plaque band stacks three centered lines plus a rule with nearly equal air gaps, so logo, title and subtitle compete instead of stepping; the title's dominance is asserted by size alone while the subtitle floats close to the rule line at y 360-425.

changes.value: Hand-hammered copper sheet wall, dense dimple texture, broad soft frontal illumination melting into a smooth darker amber vignette across the upper third so the plaque zone calms, gentle warm metallic bounce pooling low center, fine dimples fading softer toward edges, no objects, no equipment, empty material and light only
